hypothesis: Stocks whose insiders were net open-market buyers over the last 90 days outperform sector- and beta-matched peers over the next month; heavy net insider selling predicts underperformance.
rationale: Insiders know their firms best; open-market purchases in particular carry information (Lakonishok and Lee, 2001; Cohen, Malloy and Pomorski, 2012). Sales are noisier because insiders sell for many non-informational reasons.
decision_rule: If every gate passes: record as qualified, but forward testing needs a daily Form 4 feed (not included yet). If any gate fails: close H2; do not retry other windows or thresholds on 2018-2026.

forward.reason: the SEC publishes these data sets quarterly, so a live signal would be months stale. Forward testing needs a daily Form 4 feed, which this kit does not include.
